description: From the Beloi parapet above Vradeto, Vikos Gorge bends between near-vertical limestone walls, and the river is a thin line far below. The sky is clear, about 6.3°C at the Open-Meteo cell. The sun is still below the horizon. The rim is unlit. This is not the Oxia viewpoint used for GR-01-015.
